payload.claim: `EventLog.append`'s docstring promises 'Never raises', but the `try` block only catches `OSError`. `json.dumps(payload)` on line 250 can raise `TypeError` for a non-JSON-serializable value smuggled into an `Agent.event` dict (a field explicitly documented to carry a verbatim, untyped dict), and that exception would propagate to the caller in violation of the stated contract.
